fields.name: type_id
fields.description: Stable id of the aircraft type or variant: AT followed by a number (AT001), assigned in order and never reused or renumbered.

fields.name: designation
fields.description: Designation as the sources use it, including the variant (Fw 190A-8, P-47D, B-17G, Lancaster B.I). Unique per nationality.

fields.name: nationality
fields.description: Nationality (data/nationalities.csv name) of the air force that designed or first fielded the type. It can differ from the operator, which is the nationality of the unit (a Spitfire in a Polish squadron, a Lancaster built in Canada flown by the RCAF).

fields.name: role
fields.description: Main role of the type (vocabulary aircraft_role). A variant has the role of its parent unless a source gives it another (a fighter-bomber variant of a fighter family keeps its own role).

fields.name: manufacturer
fields.description: Manufacturer as the source names it (Focke-Wulf, Republic, Avro). Blank when not given.

fields.name: parent_type_id
fields.description: For a variant, the type_id of the family row it belongs to (Fw 190A-8 to Fw 190). Blank for a family or single-row type. A parent is itself not a variant.

fields.name: variant
fields.description: For a variant, its sub-designation (A-8, D-40, G, B.I). Required with parent_type_id and only then.

fields.name: performance_json
fields.description: Optional JSON object of performance figures, one key per figure (vocabulary aircraft_performance_key), each {value, unit, reference_id, note}. A key is absent when no source gives it, and a figure is never estimated. A variant row repeats only the figures that differ from its family row. Schema: schema/json/performance_json.schema.json.

fields.name: reference_ids
fields.description: Semicolon-separated reference ids (data/references_meta.csv) the row rests on. Every reference_id inside performance_json must be listed here.

fields.name: type_note
fields.description: Free text: the variant a figure is for, national terms, the number built, what the row does not cover. Uses no figure that a reference does not give.
